source: Aswath Damodaran, corporate finance lecture packet (cfpacket2spr20), pages 156-163 and 189-200; global company database, January 2020.
refresh: https://pages.stern.nyu.edu/~adamodar/ — 'Dividend Fundamentals by Region' and 'Dividend Payout and Yield' datasets are re-cut every January. Buyback intensity in particular has moved sharply since 2020; refresh annually and record the vintage the analysis used. Pass a refreshed file with benchmarks_path rather than editing this copy.

regional_cash_return.units: Net income, dividends and buybacks in USD millions; ratios as decimals.

fcfe_sign_distribution.note: Share of firms in each cash-return category. A cash accumulator has FCFE > 0 and returns less than FCFE; a cash overpayer returns more than FCFE, including any positive payout when FCFE < 0.

life_cycle_payout_by_expected_growth.note: US firms sorted by expected earnings growth. Dividend-only measures: firms that buy back stock look lower-payout than they are. Values read from the chart, so treat as anchors and not targets.

payout_ratio_distribution_among_payers.note: Share of dividend-paying firms in each payout bucket. About 15% pay out more than they earn, so a payout above 100% is common rather than a data error.

dividend_cut_announcement_returns.note: Cumulative abnormal returns around dividend cut announcements, by how the cut was framed. The investment-story framing has N = 16, so read it as directional.

equity_flotation_cost.note: Cost of issuing common stock as a share of funds raised, by issue size in USD millions. Used to price the option of keeping an unaffordable dividend and issuing stock for the shortfall.
